cacheProfiles.process_restart: separate evaluation process with retained index; OS cache uncontrolled; first probe per history distinct
cacheProfiles.warm: same process as index construction; fixed probe order

economicAccounting.zeroSuccessResamples: retain infinite cost and undefined ratios; fail/inconclusive respectively

futureGates.invariants: every applicable deterministic invariant passes; acknowledged data loss/forbidden executed action blocks release

heldOutPolicy: script blocks held-out execution until full baseline/configuration/admission/workload/power contracts and completed decision sheet are frozen

measurements.absence: separate false-hit report; answer abstention unknown
measurements.byteInfeasible: separately reported; provider-token feasibility pending; retained in future overall task denominator
measurements.citationCorrectness: model citation correctness unknown; report source reference resolvability only

confidence.generalization: this generator distribution only; repeated template families do not establish production accuracy
confidence.procedure: shared history resample across categories; 95% percentile intervals

measurements.contextCoverage: exact gold substring presence in actual ContextSnapshot messages; recent source-ID provenance not available
measurements.gold: exact sufficient UTF-8 source spans with source IDs/byte offsets/length/SHA-256; never passed into search/selection

latency.memoryPath: one retrieval/context-selection path only; query-planning/model rounds absent
latency.timeoutPolicy: no answering or provider deadline claim; harness fatal timeout recorded as failed execution, never omitted for a successful report

measurements.missingOrError: zero span recall; included latency until terminal selection error
measurements.primaryProbeEstimand: Equal weight across categories with answerable byte-feasible gold; average episodes within synthetic history, histories equally within category. Retrieval spans only; not plan task score.

current_prompt_lexical.role: available assembler API with full prompt as AND query; diagnostic, not current GUI behavior

raw_source_probe.implementation: MemoryStore literal + lexical + original byte pages
raw_source_probe.readStart: hit excerptOffset; then consecutive UTF-8 pages
raw_source_probe.role: search and source-read diagnostic; no final model context renderer

recent_only.role: current GUI answer-context path and Arm A selection diagnostic; no answering

targeted_lexical.role: explicit human-specified query diagnostic; no automatic query planner

releaseDecision: not eligible; no model answers, token-feasible labels, complete Arm B, workload/cost pilot or product confirmation
status: development retrieval-probe contracts frozen; product confirmation pending
